Name: Balanced Valley - Fishing
Author: o0MrPro
Description:
[center][/center][center][color=#ff0000][size=6]MOVED TO [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13970?tab=description]Balanced Valley[/url]﻿
FOR BETTER FEATURES AND UPDATES
THIS WILL NO LONGER BE SUPPORTED[/size][/color]


this mod balances fish prices to make fishing more profitable and fun[/center][center]I personally love fishing it's so relaxing and peaceful but at the end of the day I get back with not enough money to feed my wife and my poor kids "(
with this mod, you can enjoy fishing without worrying about money, fishes now give a reasonable amount of money based on their difficulty![/center][center][b].
[size=4].
[/size].[/b][/center][center][size=3][u][/u][/size][/center][center][size=3][b]Features[/b][/size]
▼
[size=3][b]↬ Balanced Mode ↫
[/b]- Balanced fish prices[/size]
[size=3]- this mode is balanced to be used with my other mods for a balanced playthrough[/size]
[size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12900]Balanced Valley - Realistic Farming[/url]﻿
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13016]Balanced Valley - Fishing﻿
[/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13172]Balanced Valley - Mining[/url][/size]
[color=#999999][size=2]however, you still can use it without them
[/size][/color]
[size=3][b]↬ Normal Mode ↫
[/b]- same features as balanced mode.[/size]
[size=3]- 50% more profit than balanced mode (balanced and more profitable than vanilla)
- you can use it as a standalone version or even with my other mods if you want more fishing profit[/size]
[size=3]
[size=3][b]↬ Challenging Legendary Fish ↫
[/b]- If enabled, all [u]vanilla[/u] legendary fish will be as hard as the [b]Legend [/b]and worth the same price[/size]
[size=3]- works in both balanced and normal mode
- this will not affect the legendary fish in Qi's quest[/size]

[b]↬ The mod now balances custom fish added by other mods ↫
[/b]SUPPORTED MODS:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded
[/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village[/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6626]
[/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5787]East Scarp[/url][/size]

[size=3][b]↬ Spreadsheet data ↫
[/b][/size][size=3][url=https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1lA43aWE94Nvz1BKBzi7EtiHwNBx_PCqZVxAdpVqBFhk/edit?usp=sharing](you can check and compare all changes for vanilla and modded fish here)[/url]﻿﻿﻿﻿
[/size]
[size=3][b]Config[/b]
▼[/size][size=3]
[b]Balance Mode[/b] [Balanced Mode, Normal Mode] default is [b]Balance Mode[/b]
this will change the balance mode of vanilla fish only

[b][b]Challenging Legendary Fish[/b][/b] [true, false] default is [b]false[/b]
this will enable/disable the Challenging Legendary Fish feature

[b]"Mod Name"[/b] [true, false] default is [b]true[/b]
a list of mods to toggle each mod individually (check supported mods above)
also if you don't have the mod you [u]don't[/u] need to toggle it to false
[/size][/center]
[center][size=3][b]Requirements & Install[/b][/size][/center][center][size=3]- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI
[/url]- ﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5005]
[/url]﻿﻿﻿- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿ (optional if you want to edit the mode in-game)[/size][/center][center][size=3]
unzip and put the folder into your mods folder
ALWAYS DELETE THE LAST VERSION BEFORE INSTALLING A NEW VERSION.[/size][/center][center][size=3]
[u]Compatibility[/u]
Compatible with any mod that doesn't change vanilla fish prices.
Compatible with mobile and multiplayer (everyone has to install the mod)
works fine with mods that add custom fishes.
[/size][/center][center][size=3][b].
.
.[/b]
all in all, I hope you guys like this mod, if you have any bugs or ideas to improve this mod I'm all ears for you, take care :D[/size][/center]
